query: I just got back from trying that new matcha bakery downtown this morning, their matcha croissant was so flaky and not too sweet, I even picked up a box of their hojicha cookies to bring to my roommate later. Oh and on my walk there I saw the cutest golden retriever puppy wearing a little rain boot on one paw, its owner said it stepped on a thorn a few days ago and it’s almost healed up. I also spent last night binging the new season of that mystery show everyone’s been talking about, the plot twist at the end of episode 3 had me actually gasping out loud. Anyway, I’m abroad right now and my mobile data isn’t working at all – I already checked my data usage and I hit the monthly limit, data mode is toggled off on my settings, roaming isn’t turned on either, and the VPN I usually use has been super glitchy and won’t connect properly, can you help me figure out how to fix this?
